helper_contracts.source_behavior: opcode whitelist Multiply/Transpose/Reshape/Select; classification itself is not a linearity proof, especially for Select branches
scalar Constant floating -> native double, integral -> int64 -> double; unsupported returns nullopt; scalar movement dereferences result
native float multiplier cast to target primitive; supports floating/integral dispatch, fatal otherwise
enable_conv_operand_swap and layout insensitive; delegate external swap with virtual ConvIsLowerable callback; MarkAsChanged if true

external_contracts.source_behavior: reject grouping>1, sparsity and block scales; preserve group/pure-contraction window axes; transpose convolution roles with reversed kernel, exchanged dilations and recomputed padding; strict kernel-product profitability; fresh PrecisionConfig with swapped operand precision only; lowerability veto removes constructed convolution; final replacement preserves sharding/frontend attrs and relays control dependencies
obligations: finite int64 arithmetic and physical/numerical convolution symmetry
fresh precision config may omit other fields; compare full precision/algorithm semantics
ConvIsLowerable is virtual, base returns true; removal and auxiliary construction effects

limitations: branch/stage schemas overlap; lexical mapping is not semantic completeness
loop, alias, profile and continuing graph effects remain unproved
external swapper belongs to caller obligation; source file boundary does not exclude delegated behavior
